AIChanger doesn\'t change BlueLM settings. If holding the power button also calls BlueLM, both assistants will open. Find BlueLM (蓝心小V) in the phone settings and turn off calling it with the power button. If you turn AIChanger off later, you can turn BlueLM back on there.
AIChanger needs them to intercept the power button. Open "About phone" and tap the software version 7 times until a message says you are now a developer. Then come back here.
Enter the code shown in the AIChanger notification.
The previous pairing stopped working: the phone forgets it if debugging isn\'t used for a week. Pair again — AIChanger now turns that time limit off, so it won\'t expire again.
Wi-Fi is required. You enter the code once; after that AIChanger connects by itself.
AIChanger notifications are blocked, but the code is entered in a notification. The button below will ask to allow them or open the notification settings.
Waiting for the pairing code from the notification…
Then the button keeps working after the phone restarts. Find AIChanger in the list and turn the switch on.
Otherwise vivo puts AIChanger to sleep while it waits for Wi-Fi after a restart, and the button won\'t work. Tap AIChanger in the list and choose "Allow high power consumption".
Open "Wireless debugging" → "Pair device with pairing code" and enter the code from the dialog
Enter the six-digit code from the pairing dialog (or the port and the code separated by a space)
Couldn\'t find the pairing dialog. Enter the port and the code separated by a space, for example 37123 123456. The port is the number after the colon in the "IP address & port" line.
